items.title: HCL Tech Q2 Preview: Will the IT major narrow its guidance? 5 things to watch out for
items.description: HCL Tech is set to announce its September quarter results on October 12, with brokerages expecting 12% year-on-year profit growth and 16% revenue growth. Acquisitions, deal ramp-ups and seasonal strength are likely to support performance. Investors will track FY27 revenue guidance, margin trends, discretionary spending, deal wins and AI-led pricing pressures for clues on the company’s growth outlook.
